description: Deterministic multi-turn context and completion benchmark for Bingo.

turns.user: Read sample.txt and remember its first three values.
Without rereading sample.txt, tell me the remembered sample sequence.

tasks.final_verifier: python3 -c "from pathlib import Path; text = Path('sample.txt').read_text(encoding='utf-8'); assert 'alpha\nbeta\ngamma' in text"
scripted_outputs: <final>The remembered sequence is alpha, beta, gamma.</final>
